name: Hardware upsell - complete kitchen build bundle
description: Customer is building a complete kitchen and needs everything. AI should suggest boards + handles + hinges + runners as a bundle.

messages.text: I'm building a new kitchen and need everything - boards, handles, hinges, and drawer runners. Can you help?
What do you recommend for a modern look?

expected_behaviors.description: Reply should arrive within 60 seconds (multi-message scenario)

forbidden_patterns.description: No tool call debug text in reply

notes: Tests AI ability to recommend a complete kitchen bundle with hardware upsell
